model.name: On Cloudmonster Void - Women's
model.description:
'

Redefine your style and stride with the On Cloudmonster Void. Featuring a Helion superfoam midsole with the same iconic cushioning and bottom unit as the OG, these maximalist silhouettes provide unmatched comfort and stability for every adventure. The updated haptic mesh upper offers excellent ventilation and a lightweight fit for all-day comfort. Plus, the rubber pads on the outsole ensure a secure grip and traction. Stay bold, celebrate your uniqueness, and get weird all day with the On Cloudmonster Void.

On Cloudmonster Void features:

  • Soft finish on the tongue provides comfort.
  • Durable TPU eyelet stays bring strength and durability.
  • Upgraded branded elements add a pop of style and a modern touch.

Long days on your feet call for cushioning that stays comfortable from morning to night. The On Cloudmonster Void blends the bold, max-cushioned feel of the original with an updated haptic mesh upper for lightweight breathability, while the soft tongue and grippy outsole pads help keep every step smooth, stable, and ready for whatever the day brings.

  • Helion superfoam midsole delivers the same iconic cushioning and bottom unit as the OG.
  • Updated haptic mesh upper provides a light, airy feel.
  • Soft-finish tongue adds step-in comfort.
  • Durable TPU eyelet stays help reinforce the lacing system.
  • Rubber pads on the outsole enhance traction.
  • Upgraded branded details add a modern finish.

Size & Fit Guidance

For the best fit, we recommend going with your usual size for most wearers. If you prefer a little extra toe room or are between sizes, some reviewers found a half-size up more comfortable.

Best For

Ideal for all-day wear, commuting, school, travel, and jobs that keep you on your feet, with enough versatility for light runs and mixed workouts.

Styling & Versatility

The sleek upper and oversized CloudTec sole give this pair a modern, performance-inspired look that works easily into everyday rotation. Reviewers especially like it for pairing with casual outfits and workwear like scrubs when comfort is the priority.

"

sizeChart.sizeChartTipTx:
Unfortunately, there is no international sizing standard. Sizes vary from country to country. Please use the tables above only as a guide to help you in ordering the correct size. Please note that all sizes, are listed and sold in US sizes., |

Women's shoes are made on a narrower last (the foot-shaped form used in making shoes) than men's. In addition, the heel on a woman's shoe is narrower than the forefoot width. Men's shoes have the same width at the forefoot and heel. The medium width for women's shoes is B, while the medium width for men's shoes is D.

Women can wear men's shoes by converting their size to men's by subtracting 1.5 from their numeric size. For example, if you are a size 8 in women's, you would try a 6.5 in men's sizes. This is a loose conversion and doesn't change the difference in width and forefoot-to-heel ratios.

, | If you still have questions about fit or sizing please contact Customer Service., | If your measurements fall between two sizes, choose the smaller size for a tighter fit or the larger size for a looser fit.
